name: Eclipse Addons
author: Viboplr
description: Use Eclipse Music addons you add yourself as a fallback playback source, a downloader, and a search in Cmd+K. Paste an addon's manifest URL, test it, and put it in your order: a track nothing else can play is looked up on your addons, first enabled one wins.

permissionReasons.network:*: Talk to the Eclipse addons you add, which can be on any host
